caption:
AMD is acquiring World Labs, a startup specializing in spatial intelligence, for $8.2 billion. Fei-Fei Li, a prominent AI pioneer, will join AMD as Executive Vice President and Chief Scientist. This acquisition aims to enhance AMD's capabilities in AI and hardware integration. 🤖💡
